data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Fabrin is derived from the root word 'phbero', meaning 'to carry, bring forth'. This name was given to those who helped others grow, especially in a spiritual sense. In Christian tradition, Fabrin represents the nurturing and growth of the soul under the guidance of God. The name Fabrin carries the meaning “Sprout, grow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fabrin usually hope their child will grow to embody sprout, grow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
